rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something continuing or happening throughout a period.

example.english: I've been waiting for you ever since this morning.
example.traditional: 由朝早開始，我一直等緊你。
example.jyutping: jau4 ziu1 zou2 hoi1 ci2 ngo5 jat1 zik6 dang2 gan2 nei5

rows.note: Use this in questions asking whether something has happened at any time, as in “Have you ever V-ed?”

example.english: Have you ever been to Japan?
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2

rows.note: Use this for “ever” in negative or “only ever” statements about the whole period up to now.

example.jyutping: ngo5 cung4 loi4 dou1 mou5 ci4 dou3 gwo3

rows.note: Use this as an emphatic intensifier in an exclamation where English uses “ever” for extra emphasis.

example.jyutping: bin1 go3 zan1 hai6 wui5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 gaa3
